title: Tank Equipment Uptime and Pump Health
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reeftank:param
| stats latest(return_pump_w) as return_pump, latest(skimmer_w) as skimmer, latest(_time) as seen
| eval pump_off=if(return_pump<5,1,0), stale=if((now()-seen)>600,1,0)
description: Confirms the return pump and skimmer are drawing power and the controller is reporting, catching a stopped pump fast.
value: A stopped return pump crashes oxygen and flow within an hour; power monitoring catches the failure the controller state might hide.
implementation: Ingest equipment power draw into `index=personal`; alert when the return pump stops or telemetry goes stale.
visualization: Status panel of pump and skimmer power with a health flag.
grandmaExplanation: It checks the tank's pumps are actually running, so a stopped pump is caught before the fish are harmed.
